comparison.objective: Seal an individually ventilated cage and dock it so both rack air valves connect.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-part lid registration, bimanual cage handling, runner alignment, and valve docking.
comparison.success_condition: Top is seated, cage is home on both runners, both valves are depressed, and hands are clear.
comparison.reason: It tests sealing and docking geometry, not calibrated screw adjustment or countertorque locking.
